function.name: create_announcement
function.description: Publishes or drafts an announcement in the Google Classroom stream, optionally attaching web links or Google Drive files. If course_id is unknown, call get_courses first.

links.description: List of web URLs to attach to this announcement (e.g. ['https://github.com/...']).

drive_file_ids.description: List of Google Drive file IDs to attach.
